sections.name: collection_intro
sections.description: Brief italic serif editorial statement introducing the AW23 'Silences du Nord' collection, referencing Normandy coastlines and creative director Hélène Marchetti's third season.

sections.name: featured_pieces
sections.description: Three-item product grid with extreme whitespace featuring the Vauban 36 Handbag (€9,400), the Camille Cashmere Coat (€6,200), and the Étienne Silk Blouse (€2,150).

sections.name: editorial_film
sections.description: Full-bleed still from the campaign film 'Une Lettre à Honfleur' shot by Paolo Roversi, with a single line linking to the runway replay.

sections.name: footer
sections.description: Minimal footer with boutique cities (Paris, Milan, Tokyo, New York), client services telephone, and newsletter sign-up labeled 'Correspondance'.

sections.name: hero
sections.headline: Silences du Nord
sections.subheadline: Quarante-deux pièces · Présentées au Palais de Tokyo, 28 février 2023

sections.name: lookbook_alternation
sections.description: Full-bleed runway photographs alternating with product cards including Manteau Sologne in camel wool (€7,800), Sac Vauban 36 in noir grain (€9,400), and Bottines Astrid (€1,950).

sections.name: category_filter
sections.description: Tiny all-caps filter row at top with categories: PRÊT-À-PORTER, MAROQUINERIE, SOULIERS, ACCESSOIRES.

sections.name: gallery
sections.description: Left column with four full-height editorial photographs of the Sac Vauban 36 in Noir Calfskin, shown from front, side, interior, and on-model.

sections.name: product_info
sections.description: Right column with name 'Sac Vauban 36', price '€9,400' in tiny type, color 'Noir', and 'Reserve' button alongside 'Add to bag'.

sections.name: details_accordion
sections.description: Collapsible sections for Matières (veau grainé, doublure agneau), Savoir-faire (assembled in Fiesso d'Artico, Italy, 38 hours per piece), and Entretien.

sections.name: related_styles
sections.description: Three related pieces shown small: Sac Vauban 28, Portefeuille Astrid, and Sac Camille Mini.

sections.name: founding_story
sections.description: Long-form elegant prose describing how Augustin Delacroix-Vauban founded the house above a leather workshop on Rue Cambon, and the 1958 collaboration with sculptor Henri Laurens.

sections.name: atelier_gallery
sections.description: Black and white photographs of the Faubourg Saint-Honoré atelier showing artisans hand-stitching the Vauban handbag and the cutting room.

sections.name: craftsmanship_film
sections.description: Embedded six-minute film 'Les Mains' documenting maître artisan Jean-Pierre Olivier, 41 years at the house.

sections.name: house_codes
sections.description: Three signature codes presented as quiet vignettes: the chevron stitch, the brushed-brass V clasp, and the signature Vauban Sand lining.

sections.name: boutique_list
sections.description: Minimal typographic list of flagship addresses: 24 Rue du Faubourg Saint-Honoré Paris, Via Montenapoleone 8 Milano, Ginza Six 4F Tokyo, and 760 Madison Avenue New York.

sections.name: private_appointment
sections.description: Understated form for booking a Private Client Salon visit with fields for name, boutique preference, date, and notes to the Conseiller Privé.

sections.name: fashion_show_request
sections.description: Formal invitation request form for the SS24 show at Jardin des Tuileries on 26 September 2023, restricted to existing clients and press.

sections.name: client_services
sections.description: Discrete contact block with international Conciergerie telephone +33 1 42 60 00 23 and email correspondance@delacroix-vauban.com.
